title: GET /mssp/dashboard returns the expected top-level shape for an active MSSP provider
preconditions: Active MSSP provider with mssp_dashboard.read permission
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with success:true and data containing clients, projects, frameworkCatalog, pendingInvitations, and usage keys.

title: A freshly provisioned MSSP provider with zero managed clients renders /mssp/dashboard without error
description: Both the client-panel (mssp)/dashboard page and the Partner Portal's equivalent /dashboard page must handle relationships:[] / projects:[] gracefully.
preconditions: A brand-new MSSP provider owner logs in for the first time, before onboarding any client
steps: Log in as the new MSSP owner and land on /mssp/dashboard
Repeat against the Partner Portal build
expectedResult: Both dashboards render an empty/zero state (no clients, zero usage) with no console errors or crashed widgets.

title: The admin panel's "MSSP Partners" sidebar entry loads the provider list without error
description: vibrantix-admin-panel Sidebar.jsx links to /tenant-management/mssps, backed by adminTenantService.mssps() -> GET /admin/tenant-management/mssps (admin.controller.js listMssps).
preconditions: Platform admin session with admin:mssp scope
steps: Click "MSSP Partners" in the admin panel sidebar
expectedResult: /tenant-management/mssps loads and lists every onboarded MSSP provider with its client/framework counts, with no error toast.

title: Every page in the client-panel (mssp) route group mounts without a runtime error for a full-permission MSSP_OWNER
description: Covers all 9 pages under vibrantix-client-panel/src/app/(mssp)/mssp/: dashboard, clients, clients/new, clients/[clientOrgId], frameworks, team, invitations, requests, audit.
preconditions: Logged in as MSSP_OWNER (holds every mssp_* permission)
At least one managed client exists so clients/[clientOrgId] has a valid id to open
expectedResult: Every page renders its primary content (or an explicit, non-crashing loading/empty state) with no unhandled exception or blank white screen.
